description: Places de stationnement "zone bleue" sur la commune d'Anglet is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. Localisation des stationnements "zones bleues" sur la commune d'Anglet ayant fait l'objet d'un arrêté municipal. Qu'est-ce qu'une "zone bleue" ? Une zone bleue oblige les conducteurs à apposer un disque à l'avant de leur véhicule en stationnement, de manière à pouvoir être consulté par le personnel affecté à la surveillance de la voie publique. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are zone bleue, Places de stationnement. The portal shows 70 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
